DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOL.COM Center. EDSA corner Ouezon Avenue, West Triangle. Quezon City http: dilg.gov.ph OPINION N 114 22 DIR. REYNALDO M. BUNGUBUNCJ Regional Director DILG-Region XII Sumpay Bldg., Block IV Maranon Village Barangay Zone III, Koronadal City Dear RD Bungubung: This has reference to your letter dated 06 September 2016 seeking the Central Office's guidance on the status of Governor Daisy P. Avance-Fuentes as the Chairman and Presiding Office of the Regional Peace and Order Council (RPOC). Per your letter, Governor Fuentes was the duly appointed Chairman of the RPOC by virtue of the delegated authority to förmer Secretary Mar Roxas. It is the view of Governor Fuentes that her term as Chairman expired when her appointing authority ceased to hold office. On the other hand, it is your view that Governor Fuentes may still act as Chairman in a hold-over capacity, until her successor shall have been duly appointed and qualified. We concur with your position. Please be informed that the Department already addressed a similar issue in DILG Opinion No. 13, series of 2009. In the aforesaid legal opinion, the Department answered in the affirmative when asked whether the present RPOC Chairperson can still act as such in a hold-over capacity pending appointment by the DILG Secretary of a new RPOC Chairperson, thus: Let it be stressed that Governor Cerilles' chairmanship may fall under the category of what is known as a de facto officer, which has been defined by jurisprudence as "officer-in-fact under a color of known appointment or selection which is void because the officer was not eligible or because there was a want of power in the eleciing or appointing body, or by reason of some defect or irregularity in the exercise, such as ineligibility, want of power, clefZ•ct being unknown to the public" (Sampayan vs. Daza, 213 SCRA 807)

L.11s/17 Perforce, Governor Cerilles xxx may still validly be considered a de facto officer, which could give a semblance of authority for her to be considered in a hold-over capacity. (Emphasis Supplied) We hope to have guided you accordingly. Very ly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary 2 016-
